name: AhaSlides
summary: Interactive presentation platform — live polls, quizzes, word clouds and audience Q&A, free for up to 50 participants.
best_for: educators, trainers and event hosts running interactive sessions — polls, quizzes, word clouds and live Q&A — with audiences up to 50 free
skip_if: you need predictable, uniform pricing across a multi-country team, or your decks live in PowerPoint and a lightweight poll add-on covers it
honest_knock: AhaSlides runs regional pricing: the number on the pricing page depends on where you browse from — so any review quoting one price (including ours) may not match yours. The advertised savings assume annual commitment, and the free tier's five-quiz-slide cap nudges real quiz use toward paid.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-06 and again 2026-09-30) AhaSlides prices regionally, so the currency and the amount depend on where you buy from; the figures below are the reading from a Netherlands location on 6 September 2026, and your own country's page may show a different rate for the same tier. Free is 0 for up to 50 participants, with unlimited events and unlimited presentations but only 5 Quiz and 3 Unscored slides per deck. Essential is €7.25 per month billed yearly and lifts the ceiling to 100 participants, adding unlimited interactive slides, analytics and exports, and folder management. Pro AI is €10.65 per month billed yearly, raises the ceiling to 2,500 participants and adds the AI features, custom branding, Q&A moderation and priority support. Enterprise is quote-only, listed at up to 100,000 participants with SSO and SCIM offered on demand. Two discounts sit on top: yearly billing is advertised at up to 67% below monthly, and team licences bought together save up to a further 20%. AhaSlides' own USD listing puts Essential at $95.40 a year, which is the same tier at a different regional price rather than a second plan — so check the page from your own country before you budget. Read again from the same Netherlands location on 30 September 2026, both yearly rates were unchanged, and the monthly toggle showed what the yearly discount is measured against: €22.75 a month for Essential and €46.75 for Pro AI. The team calculator's default of 3 Pro AI licences on yearly billing came to €345.06 a year instead of €383.40, a 10% saving (it takes 2 to 30 licences). Each paid card carries a 100% money-back guarantee line.
